spellcaster.name: Arcane Mentality
spellcaster.description: Gain 1 free action /round that can only be used to maintain concentration.

spellcaster.name: Arcane Mindset
spellcaster.description: You can maintain concentration on one spell without paying the action cost.

spellcaster.name: Augmented Mentality
spellcaster.description: Gain a second free action /round that can only be used to maintain concentration.

spellcaster.name: Careful Casting
spellcaster.description: Add +1 to both weaving dice for every 3 actions spent casting.

spellcaster.name: Chaos Mastery
spellcaster.description: Mastery of Chaos (White) magic. Each rank improves your weaving die and max spell level.

spellcaster.name: Chi Mastery
spellcaster.description: Mastery of Chi (Green) magic. Each rank improves your weaving die and max spell level. +1 Torso HP/rank.

spellcaster.name: Draw Mana
spellcaster.description: 10-minute ritual, 4-hour cooldown. Roll all weaving dice, sum = new mana total.

spellcaster.name: Elemental Mastery
spellcaster.description: Mastery of Elemental (Red) magic. Each rank improves your weaving die and max spell level.

spellcaster.name: Enduring Inscriptions
spellcaster.description: Your enchantments on items last twice as long.

spellcaster.name: Expanded Horizons
spellcaster.description: +1 to maximum spells known /rank.

spellcaster.name: Focused Will
spellcaster.description: Your weaving dice cannot be reduced below their base value by any effect.

spellcaster.name: Hedge Wizard
spellcaster.description: Gain access to one spell school without mastery, using a single d4 weaving die. Choose school on purchase.

spellcaster.name: Mana Font
spellcaster.description: +1 to mana recovery total /rank (Mana Mean bonus).

spellcaster.name: Mana Mastery
spellcaster.description: Rank 1: Reroll 1s. Rank 2: Also reroll 2s on d6+. Rank 3: Also reroll 3s on d8+. Rank 4: Also reroll 4s on d10+.

spellcaster.name: Master Weaver
spellcaster.description: All your weaving dice improve by one size (e.g. d8 becomes d10, d10 becomes d12).

spellcaster.name: Order Mastery
spellcaster.description: Mastery of Order (Black) magic. Each rank improves your weaving die and max spell level. +1 extra spell known/rank.

spellcaster.name: Quick Counter
spellcaster.description: You may attempt a Spell Spotting check as a free action once per round.

spellcaster.name: Re-Weaving
spellcaster.description: Once per round, if your weaving fails you may immediately attempt again at -5 to both dice.

spellcaster.name: Somatic Casting
spellcaster.description: You can weave spells while bound or restrained, using only body movement.

spellcaster.name: Source Seizing
spellcaster.description: Fast mana recovery — 3 consecutive WP checks 25, takes Torso damage each action. Dangerous.

spellcaster.name: Spell Thrower
spellcaster.description: Touch spells can be thrown up to 20 feet.

spellcaster.name: Spellcrafting
spellcaster.description: +1 Spell Hook /rank.

spellcaster.name: Summoner's Silence
spellcaster.description: You can communicate with summoned creatures telepathically within 100 feet.

spellcaster.name: Touch Master
spellcaster.description: +10 feet to the range of all touch spells /rank.

spellcaster.name: Verbal Casting
spellcaster.description: You can weave spells using only verbal components — no hands required.

spellcaster.name: Will Mastery
spellcaster.description: Mastery of Will (Blue) magic. Each rank improves your weaving die and max spell level. +1 Spell Hook per 3 ranks.

spellcaster.name: Arcane Aim
spellcaster.description: +1 Precision with all touch spells /rank. Total Precision can never exceed 25.

guild.name: Formic Casting
guild.description: You can cast Druid form spells while in animal form.

guild.name: Enduring Ghost
guild.description: Your Ghost Armor spells have double the number of hits before failing.

guild.name: Smart Spells
guild.description: Your AOE spells can exclude targets of your choice.

guild.name: Totem Lag
guild.description: Your totem effects persist for 1 round after concentration ends.

guild.name: Speedy Summon
guild.description: Summoning soulbound creatures costs 1 fewer action.

guild.name: Guided Wrath
guild.description: Your evocation AOE spells can be shaped to exclude a 5-foot path.

guild.name: Blade of Shadow
guild.description: Your summoned creatures gain Shadow Step — can teleport up to 10 feet /action.

guild.name: Source Seizure
guild.description: Source Seizing costs 0 actions instead of 1.

guild.name: Careful Conjuring
guild.description: Augment and Grow creature spells have their Constitution check reduced by 5.

guild.name: Arcane Lore
guild.description: +25 on all Magic Lore and Identify checks.

divine.name: Patron's Mark
divine.description: Receive the Mark of a Divine Patron. Choose a patron: Blood, Death, Iron, Life, Light, Mischief, Passion, Storms, War, or Wisdom. Gates all other Divine skills.

divine.name: Divine Resilience
divine.description: Reduce all damage taken by 1 /rank while your patron's aura is active.

divine.name: Divine Auras
divine.description: Unlock one Divine Aura of your patron /rank. Max 4 auras (5 with Mark of Wisdom or Mark of Favour).

divine.name: Exalted Auras
divine.description: Your auras affect all allies within range, not just yourself.

divine.name: Divine Defence
divine.description: Choose one Divine Defence available to your patron.

divine.name: Divine Healing
divine.description: Choose one Divine Healing ability available to your patron.

divine.name: Divine Offence
divine.description: Choose one Divine Offence ability available to your patron.

divine.name: Benediction
divine.description: Choose one Benediction available to your patron.

divine.name: Champion's Choice
divine.description: Gain a second Divine Offence ability.

divine.name: Mark of Favour
divine.description: Your patron has elevated you to a higher standing. +1 Divine Aura slot (max 5). GM granted only.

balance.name: Studious Dedication
balance.description: Commit to the path of inner mastery. Gates all Balance skills. While in combat you must be unarmed and unarmored to maintain your discipline.

balance.name: Chi Shield
balance.description: Build an emergency reserve of Chi HP. Passively: 1 HP /point applied before critical damage. Actively: spend points to reduce magic damage by 1d6/point to all affected locations.

balance.name: Wind Stance
balance.description: While in Wind Stance: +1 foot/action movement and +1 Evasion /rank. -1 to all ranged attacks against you per 2 ranks (round down). Rank 3: Wall jump at double normal height. Rank 6: Run along walls briefly. Rank 9: Run on water briefly. Switching stances costs 1 action (0 with Stance Dancing).

balance.name: Wave Stance
balance.description: While in Wave Stance: +1 Expertise, +1 Precision and +1 on all Dexterity checks /rank. Switching stances costs 1 action (0 with Stance Dancing).

balance.name: Stone Stance
balance.description: While in Stone Stance: +1 Damage and +1 on all Strength checks /rank. Switching stances costs 1 action (0 with Stance Dancing).

balance.name: Flame Stance
balance.description: While in Flame Stance: Your Chi Shield has double effect (2 HP or 2d6 /point). Gain advantage on all Constitution and Willpower checks. Switching stances costs 1 action (0 with Stance Dancing).

balance.name: Stance Dancing
balance.description: Switching stances now costs 0 actions instead of 1. You cannot switch stances twice in the same melee round.

balance.name: Martial Artist
balance.description: When fighting unarmed you use d12 instead of d10 for combat and d4 instead of d3 for damage.

balance.name: Awakened Focus
balance.description: You can cure yourself of fear and paralysis by passing an instant Inner Focus check (1 action).

balance.name: Enlightened Focus
balance.description: Cure fear, paralysis, disease, poison, charm and curse effects via Inner Focus check. Each requires a successful skill roll.

balance.name: The Search for Enlightenment
balance.description: +1 to all attribute check bonuses /rank. Does not raise attributes.

balance.name: Zen in Motion
balance.description: Once per round, roll a WP or AW check 25. If passed, gain 1 extra action this turn. No penalty for failure.

infernal.name: Demonic Contract
infernal.description: Sign a contract with a demon. Gates all Infernal skills. The terms are between you and the demon.

infernal.name: Corruption
infernal.description: Tracked resource. Increases through use of infernal skills. High corruption has consequences.

infernal.name: Cursed Blade
infernal.description: One weapon of yours becomes cursed. Choose Blade or Bow — mutually exclusive. The weapon gains infernal properties.

infernal.name: Cursed Bow
infernal.description: One ranged weapon of yours becomes cursed. Mutually exclusive with Cursed Blade.

infernal.name: Blight/Smite
infernal.description: Channel infernal energy through your cursed weapon for a devastating strike.

infernal.name: Glyph of Union
infernal.description: Create a binding glyph that links you to a target creature.

infernal.name: Consuming Kiss
infernal.description: Drain life force through physical contact.

infernal.name: Flash
infernal.description: Teleport instantly up to 30 feet. Costs corruption.

infernal.name: Highlight
infernal.description: Mark a target so all your attacks against them gain +5 Precision for the round.

infernal.name: Project
infernal.description: Project your senses to a location you have visited within the last week.

infernal.name: Kettle Vine
infernal.description: Conjure writhing infernal vines that restrain targets in an area.

infernal.name: Spiritual Hammer
infernal.description: Conjure a spectral weapon that attacks independently.

lycanthropy.name: Lycanthropy
lycanthropy.description: You have been infected with lycanthropy. Gates all Lycanthropy skills. Lunar phase affects your abilities.

lycanthropy.name: Control the Beast
lycanthropy.description: Resist involuntary transformation. Pass a WP check (difficulty varies with lunar phase).

lycanthropy.name: Partial Shift
lycanthropy.description: Shift specific body parts without full transformation. Costs 1 action.

lycanthropy.name: Ferocity
lycanthropy.description: +1 damage /rank while transformed. Scales with lunar phase.

lycanthropy.name: Regeneration
lycanthropy.description: Recover 1 HP /round while transformed. Enhanced near full moon.

lycanthropy.name: Pack Bond
lycanthropy.description: Communicate telepathically with other lycanthropes within 1 mile.

stanceNotes.switchingCost: 1 action without Stance Dancing, 0 actions with Stance Dancing
stanceNotes.switchingLimit: Cannot switch stances twice in the same melee round
stanceNotes.activeStance: Only one stance can be active at a time
stanceNotes.prerequisite: Studious Dedication required for all stance skills

lunarPhases.2: Near Full Moon — enhanced abilities, harder to control
lunarPhases.3: Full Moon Night — maximum power, hardest to control
